citation: William (Bill) Tyre, Glessner House, statement on the Glessners' cooks, relayed in writing by the project's owner, 13 November 2026.
author: William Tyre (Glessner House), as relayed by the project's owner
locator: The owner's message of 13 November 2026: Kate Ryan 'was the temporary summer cook in Chicago while Mattie was in New Hampshire with the family. They only ever had one cook at a time.'
access_notes: Not seen in Mr Tyre's own writing: the owner relayed it after talking with him. Recorded 2026-11-13 (T-3590).
note: The Glessner House's own historian on the household's cooks. It explains the 1900 census, which was taken on 1 June while the family and Mattie Williamson were at The Rocks and found Kate Ryan cooking for the house, and it rules that she was not part of the household the rest of the year.
what_it_supplies: the Glessners kept one cook at a time: Mattie Williamson, in the years she cooked for them
Kate Ryan was a temporary summer cook in Chicago while Mattie Williamson was in New Hampshire with the family
what_it_does_not_supply: which summers Kate Ryan cooked for the house, beyond the census of 1900
